prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one fine-line plate for the heritage collection Fanggu. Image 1 is LINE STYLE ONLY, the Vairocana contour master. Image 2 is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY. Create a refined sparse BLACK INK line drawing on perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF. Match elegant delicate thin organic contours, restrained internal detail, generous white surfaces. No fills, shadows, grey shading, crosshatching, grain, paper texture, gradients, halos or checkerboards. Door recesses are outlines, not black blocks. Show the selected subject complete and centered with 8% margins, verticals vertical and minimal perspective; photograph fixes identity and proportions. Remove tourists, trees, foliage, vehicles, wires, signs, clutter and sky. No letters, calligraphy, labels, captions, border or watermark. BUST ONLY as photograph: head, long ears, shoulders, robe and chest terminating with a natural lower outline; do not invent legs or a full pedestal. Wide serene head with rows of tight hair curls. Preserve the actual damaged rock surfaces and a small adjoining cliff contour. Portrait 1024x1536, subject about 82% of height.
